findings.text: follow-on: the node was fenced to five write paths and this file, with skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md:66, is not among them; the fragment's scope paragraph records that registering the view on the dispatcher alone reddens tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py with "the crew view dispatcher serves these views and the crew tool does not advertise: ['forgotten']", so the edit is required by a gate the plan itself names and is isolated in a commit of its own for the coordinator to keep or drop, but the fence deviation itself is the coordinator's to adjudicate.

follow-on: the case asserts only that the listed row's classification is one of three accepted values and never builds a promoted or recorded pointer, so the "unpromoted" half of the predicate at reckon/crew/forgotten_runs.py:43 rests on the settled-state overwrite at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1616 instead of on a case, and a regression that stopped filtering settled pointers would leave all four cases green.

VERDICT done_when: the plan's section 10 measure names tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py building a temporary RECKON_HOME with three pointers, listing exactly the second with its age and recover action, an eight-hour threshold listing nothing, an executed negative control, and a no-dispatch guard with its positive control; tests/test_forgotten_runs_are_reported.py:188, :212, :220 and :252 are those four cases, logs/head-arm.log records them green inside "1 failed, 112 passed in 291.52s" and logs/negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 with the follower-liveness condition removed. The further requirement that tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py, tests/test_mcp_vocabulary_is_complete.py and tests/test_ledger.py add no failure against base holds: head-arm.log "1 failed, 112 passed" against base-arm.log "2 failed, 107 passed", and tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py::test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window fails in BOTH arms on reckon/ledger.py's pre-existing 51666-token size, so the after-minus-base failure set is empty.

VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed head with a clean worktree; status complete, the tests: line is the literal command logs/head-arm.log repeats in its own "# command:" header, negative_control_log names one bare path whose log ends EXIT=1 with a failing id the head arm does not fail, baseline_suite and after_suite are both armed JSON with completed true and their logs on disk, and failure_attribution attributes both residual ids to scaffolding.
